title: Bulls and Bears
description: Learn the most common animal terms in the stock market.

slides.title: The Bull Market
slides.content: A 'Bull Market' is when stock prices are rising or are expected to rise. Bulls attack by thrusting their horns UP!

slides.title: The Bear Market
slides.content: A 'Bear Market' is when prices are falling and investors are pessimistic. Bears attack by swiping their paws DOWN!

slides.title: Market Sentiment
slides.content: These terms describe the overall attitude (or sentiment) of investors. You can also be 'bullish' or 'bearish' on a single stock.

quiz.question: If you believe the price of a stock is going to go UP, you are...

options.explanation: Correct! Bulls attack upwards, symbolizing rising prices.
